outbound.title: Outbound Network
outbound.description: Control the platform policy for outbound HTTP and HTTPS connections.
outbound.saveFailed: Outbound network policy could not be saved.
outbound.loadFailed: Outbound network policy could not be loaded.
outbound.resetSuccess: Outbound network policy reset to its default.
outbound.resetFailed: Outbound network policy could not be reset.
outbound.noProxyPlaceholder: Add a host, CIDR, or domain pattern
outbound.noProxySemantics: Compatible with standard NO_PROXY matching semantics.

scope.title: Policy Scope
scope.description: The policy only affects platform-initiated HTTP(S) requests.

overview.healthyDescription: The latest fixed-target diagnostic passed and the current policy is active.
overview.degradedDescription: The latest fixed-target diagnostic failed. Review runtime state and proxy configuration.
overview.unverifiedDescription: The current policy is loaded but has no saved-policy diagnostic result yet.

routing.title: Outbound Routing
routing.description: Define how platform HTTP(S) clients select proxy and bypass rules.

mode.title: Connection Mode
mode.description: Direct connections do not use retained proxy endpoints.

proxy.title: Proxy Endpoints
proxy.description: Configure proxies for HTTP and HTTPS independently. Proxy routing requires at least one endpoint.
proxy.required: Configure at least one proxy endpoint before enabling proxy routing.

bypass.title: Bypass Rules
bypass.description: Matching hosts and networks bypass configured proxies.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Test a fixed registered target with the current saved effective policy.
diagnostics.failedMessage: The connectivity diagnostic could not be completed.
diagnostics.noHistory: This target has no saved diagnostic records.
